[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 9: All-Ages Content Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]9.1[/color] This is an all-ages server. Erotic roleplay (ERP) and sexual content of any kind are forbidden everywhere: in-character, subtle, whispers, LOOC, OOC, PDA messages, radio, paper, and descriptions.
[color=#a4885c]9.2[/color] Do not make sexual jokes, innuendo, or references, and do not describe characters, items, or actions in a sexual way.
[color=#a4885c]9.3[/color] Any romantic roleplay must stay light and age-appropriate. If you are unsure whether something is appropriate, don't do it.
[color=#a4885c]9.4[/color] Character names, appearances, descriptions, and OOC preference notes must be free of sexual content.
[color=#a4885c]9.5[/color] If anyone makes you uncomfortable or breaks these rules, Ahelp immediately. Breaking this section may result in an immediate ban.
